subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Capture
solution:
The correct answer is: **Arrest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Capture"** means to take into one's possession or control, often by force. It can refer to physically seizing something or figuratively capturing attention or interest. (पकड़ना/क़ब्जा करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers managed to capture the enemy base after a long battle.
 
 
 
• **"Arrest"** refers to the act of seizing someone by legal authority, especially in the context of law enforcement. (गिरफ्तार करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The police were able to arrest the suspect after gathering enough evidence.
 
 
 
• Since both "Capture" and "Arrest" involve taking control or seizing, they are synonyms.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Arrest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Shorten** (छोटा करना): To make something smaller in length, duration, or extent.

 
 
• **Example:** He decided to shorten his vacation due to urgent work commitments.
 
 
 
• **Release** (रिहा करना): To set free or allow to go.
 
 
• **Example:** The prisoner was released after completing his sentence.
 
 
 
• **Attain** (प्राप्त करना): To achieve or accomplish something after effort.
 
 
• **Example:** She worked hard to attain her dream of becoming a doctor.
 
 

32:T50d,
The correct answer is **option 2.**
